title: Aqeedah: The Foundation of Tawheed
description: Comprehensive study of Islamic creed (Aqeedah عقيدة) focusing on Tawhid (توحيد) - monotheism - as taught by the Salaf. This course covers the three categories of Tawheed, the names and attributes of Allah, and the foundations of correct Islamic belief.
short_description: Master the fundamentals of Islamic creed and Tawheed

modules.title: Foundations of Aqeedah
modules.description: Understanding the meaning and importance of Islamic creed.

lessons.title: What is Aqeedah?
lessons.content: Understanding the meaning of Aqeedah (عقيدة) - Islamic creed - and why it is the foundation upon which all acts of worship are built.

lessons.title: The Three Categories of Tawheed
lessons.content: Understanding the division of Tawheed (توحيد) into three categories: Tawheed ar-Rububiyyah, Tawheed al-Uluhiyyah, and Tawheed al-Asma wa's-Sifat.

lessons.title: Tawheed ar-Rububiyyah
lessons.content: Understanding Allah's Lordship (ربوبية) - His creation, sovereignty, and control over all affairs.

modules.title: Tawheed in Worship
modules.description: Understanding the unity of worship and what constitutes Shirk.

lessons.title: Tawheed al-Uluhiyyah
lessons.content: Understanding the unity of worship (إلوهية) - directing all forms of worship exclusively to Allah alone.

lessons.title: The Types of Shirk
lessons.content: Understanding Shirk (شرك) - polytheism - in its major and minor forms, and how to guard against it.

lessons.title: Du'a and Supplication
lessons.content: The central role of Du'a (دعاء) in worship and why supplication is the essence of the religion.

modules.title: Names and Attributes of Allah
modules.description: Understanding and affirming the names and attributes of Allah as mentioned in the Qur'an and Sunnah.

lessons.title: Affirming Allah's Names
lessons.content: Understanding and affirming the beautiful names of Allah (أسماء الله الحسنى) as mentioned in the Qur'an and Sunnah.

lessons.title: Allah's Attributes Without Tahrif
lessons.content: Affirming Allah's attributes (صفات) without distortion (تحريف), nullification (نفي), or asking 'how' (كيفية).

lessons.title: The Greatest Name of Allah
lessons.content: Understanding the importance of knowing Allah through His names and attributes and the virtue of calling upon Him.
